name: Loveless Losers
storyline: Serafina is nervous and excited for her first day of high school, and she needs your help picking out the perfect outfit to make friends and impress her classmates.
summary: A retro Game Boy-style psychological horror and dress-up game. Mix and match Y2K and J-Fashion inspired clothes, shoes, and hairstyles in a nostalgic pixel-art wardrobe, while exploring Serafina's changing bedroom via point-and-click mechanics to uncover hidden secrets and a darker underlying narrative.
